scope: Actual worker retry escalation from historical counts seeded before startup, across exponential and capped backoff boundaries; no running clock or retry state mutation

cases.name: second_attempt
seed: UPDATE issuance_service.canvas_oauth_connections SET revoke_retry_count=1 WHERE id='worker-rest-connection'

cases.name: last_uncapped_base
seed: UPDATE issuance_service.canvas_oauth_connections SET revoke_retry_count=9 WHERE id='worker-rest-connection'

cases.name: first_capped_base
seed: UPDATE issuance_service.canvas_oauth_connections SET revoke_retry_count=10 WHERE id='worker-rest-connection'

cases.name: exponent_cap
seed: UPDATE issuance_service.canvas_oauth_connections SET revoke_retry_count=11 WHERE id='worker-rest-connection'

cases.name: historical_large_count
seed: UPDATE issuance_service.canvas_oauth_connections SET revoke_retry_count=999 WHERE id='worker-rest-connection'
